description: This is a PHP unit test class for the LocalizationAPI class within the OrangeHRM Admin API plugin. It contains tests for retrieving and updating localization settings, validating parameters, and ensuring certain methods are not implemented (e.g., create, delete, getAll). The file also mocks dependencies such as ConfigService and LocalizationService to verify interactions.

classes.name: LocalizationAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the LocalizationAPI methods, including retrieval, update, validation rules, and ensuring unimplemented methods throw exceptions.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of localization settings and asserts the returned values match expected default language and date format.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Verifies the validation rules for the getOne method include the required ID parameter.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating localization settings and verifies the correct methods are called with expected parameters.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Checks validation rules for updating localization, using fixtures to test valid and invalid input cases.

methods.name: testAll
methods.description: Ensures the getAll method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForAll
methods.description: Ensures validation for getAll throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Confirms the create method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Confirms validation for create throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures the delete method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures validation for delete throws a not implemented exception.
